scanNote:
2-mashqning 1-bandi ('Take the first ......... on your left') ikki xil to'ldirilishi mumkin: 'TURNING' (Britaniya inglizchasida yo'nalish ko'rsatishning odatiy shakli) yoki 'TURN'. Enterprise — Britaniya kitobi, shuning uchun 'turning' ko'zda tutilgan; lekin 'turn' ham grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri. 'corner' esa bu qurilmada ishlatilmaydi.

1-mashqning 11-bandida 'Can you ...?' ham, 'Could you ...?' ham to'g'ri (ikkinchisi muloyimroq).

1-mashqning 19-bandida 'What kind of music', 'What sort of music', 'What type of music' — uchalasi ham to'g'ri.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh joylarni tushib qolgan so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  was born
   2  did
   3  Did you have
   4  last time
   5  were
   6  didn't have
   7  Who was
   8  weren't
   9  What was
  10  same
  11  can you
  12  Who
  13  couldn't
  14  had
  15  he didn't
  16  How many
  17  corner of
  18  on
  19  What kind
  20  couldn't

⚠ 3, 7, 9, 12, 16, 19-bandlar GAP BOShIDA
turadi → kitobda BOSh HARF bilan.


──── PAST SIMPLE: 'TO BE' ────

 5  'WHERE WERE you yesterday? — At home.'
    'you' → WERE.

 8  'There were guest houses but there
     WEREN'T any hotels then.'
    ko'plik inkor → WEREN'T.

 9  'WHAT WAS the weather like in Madrid?
     — It WAS hot.'
    'the weather' — birlik → WAS.

  ⚠ JADVAL:
     I / he / she / it → WAS / WASN'T
     you / we / they   → WERE / WEREN'T


──── PAST SIMPLE: BOShQA FE'LLAR ────

 2  'What DID you have for lunch YESTERDAY?'
 3  'DID YOU HAVE a dog when you were six?
     — No, I didn't.'
 6  'They had bicycles but they DIDN'T HAVE
     cars then.'
14  'They HAD two sons, but they didn't have
     any daughters.'
15  'Did he travel by plane? — No, HE
     DIDN'T.'

  ⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
     'DID' va 'DIDN'T' dan keyin ASOSIY
     ShAKL!

        'They DIDN'T HAVE cars.'   ✓
        'They didn't HAD cars.'    ✗
        'What DID you HAVE?'       ✓
        'What did you HAD?'        ✗

     Lekin tasdiqda 2-shakl:
        'They HAD two sons.'  ✓

  ⚠ 14-BAND — BIR GAPDA IKKALASI:
     'They HAD two sons, but they DIDN'T
      HAVE any daughters.'
     tasdiq → HAD (2-shakl);
     inkor → DIDN'T HAVE (asosiy shakl).


──── 'COULD' / 'COULDN'T' ────

13  'He COULD talk when he was one, but he
     COULDN'T walk.'
20  'James COULDN'T read until he was
     seven.'

  ⚠ 'could' — 'can' ning O'TMISh shakli.
  Keyin ASOSIY shakl:
     'he couldn't WALK'  ✓
     'he couldn't WALKED' ✗


──── SAVOL SO'ZLARI ────

 7  'WHO WAS Elvis Presley? — An American
     singer.'
    Javob ODAM haqida → WHO.

12  'WHO did you go out with? — James.'
    Javob ODAM ismi → WHO.
    ⚠ Predlog 'with' GAP OXIRIDA qoladi.

16  'HOW MANY operas did he write? —
     Forty.'
    'operas' — sanaladigan ko'plik →
    HOW MANY.

19  'WHAT KIND of music does the band play?
     — Rock.'
    ⚠ 'What SORT of' / 'What TYPE of' ham
    to'g'ri.


──── YO'NALISh KO'RSATISh (Unit 10) ────

11  'Excuse me, CAN YOU tell me the way to
     the bank?'
    ⚠ 'COULD you ...?' ham to'g'ri
    (muloyimroq).
    'tell somebody THE WAY TO ...' —
    turg'un ibora.

17  'The supermarket is on the CORNER OF
     Oak Street and Hill Street.'
    'on the corner of X and Y' = X va Y
    ko'chalarining burchagida.

18  'The bank is ON your right.'
    ⚠ 'ON your right/left' — predlog 'on'.


──── LUG'AT ────

 1  'He WAS BORN in 1938 and DIED in 1987.'
    ⚠ 'be born' — majhul nisbat!
       'He WAS BORN.'    ✓
       'He born.'        ✗
       'He was borned.'  ✗

    Lekin 'die' — oddiy fe'l:
       'He DIED in 1987.'  ✓

 4  'When was the LAST TIME you visited your
     parents?'
    'the last time' = oxirgi marta.

10  'My town isn't the SAME as it was thirty
     years ago.'
    ⚠ 'the SAME AS' — turg'un birikma.
       'the same AS'    ✓
       'the same LIKE'  ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to be born  = tug'ilmoq
  to die      = vafot etmoq
  a bicycle   = velosiped
  a guest house = mehmon uyi
  the same as = ... bilan bir xil
  the way to  = ... ga yo'l
  an opera    = opera
  a supermarket = supermarket
  a corner    = burchak
  a band      = musiqiy guruh
  rock        = rok (musiqa)
  a daughter  = qiz (farzand)

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'BE BORN' — MAJHUL NISBAT:
  'He WAS BORN.'    ✓
  'He born.'        ✗
  'He was borned.'  ✗

Lekin 'die' — oddiy fe'l: 'He DIED in 1987.'

3-mashqning 5-bandi ham shu mavzuda.

items.sentence: 2  What ..................... you have for lunch yesterday?

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: 'YESTERDAY' → PAST SIMPLE savoli
→ DID.

⚠ 'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'did you HAVE'  ✓
  'did you HAD'   ✗

KALIT: javob 'No, I DIDN'T' → savol 'DID YOU
...?' bilan boshlanadi.

'when you WERE six' — o'tmish.

ASOSIY shakl: 'did you HAVE'.

items.sentence: 4  When was the ..................... you visited your parents?

commonMistake.whyUz:
'the LAST TIME' = oxirgi marta.

'When was the last time you ...?' — turg'un
savol.

3-mashqning 3-bandi AYNAN shu qurilma.

items.sentence: 5  'Where ..................... you yesterday?'  'At home.'

commonMistake.whyUz:
'you' → WERE (Past Simple 'be').

  I/he/she/it → WAS
  you/we/they → WERE

⚠ 'Where DID you be?' — XATO! 'be' fe'li
'did' talab qilmaydi.

items.sentence: 6  They had bicycles but they ..................... cars then.
items.uz: Ularda velosiped bor edi, lekin o'shanda mashina yo'q edi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
INKOR → DIDN'T + ASOSIY shakl:
  'didn't HAVE'  ✓
  'didn't HAD'   ✗

Bir gapda: 'HAD' (tasdiq, 2-shakl) va
'DIDN'T HAVE' (inkor, asosiy shakl).

items.sentence: 7  '..................... Elvis Presley?'  'An American singer.'

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: javob ODAM haqida ('An American
singer') → WHO.

O'tmish → WAS ('Elvis Presley' birlik).

'What was Elvis Presley?' — kasbi so'ralganda
ham ishlatiladi, lekin 'Who' tabiiyroq.

items.sentence: 8  There were guest houses but there ..................... any hotels then.
items.uz: Mehmon uylari bor edi, lekin o'shanda mehmonxonalar yo'q edi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'hotels' — KO'PLIK, inkor → WEREN'T.

'There WERE ...' (tasdiq) va 'there WEREN'T
ANY ...' (inkor) — bir gapda.

⚠ Inkorda 'any' ('some' emas).

items.sentence: 9  '..................... the weather like in Madrid?'  'It was hot.'

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'What ... the weather LIKE?' — 'like' SHART!

Javob 'It WAS hot' — o'tmish → WAS.
'the weather' — birlik → WAS.

4-nazorat testining 3-mashqi hozirgi zamonda
edi: 'What's the weather like TODAY?'

items.sentence: 10  My town isn't the .......... as it was thirty years ago.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ 'the SAME AS' — TURG'UN BIRIKMA:
  'the same AS'    ✓
  'the same LIKE'  ✗
  'the same THAN'  ✗

Bo'sh joydan keyin 'as' allaqachon bosilgan.

items.sentence: 11  Excuse me, ............... tell me the way to the bank?
items.uz: Kechirasiz, bankka boradigan yo'lni ayta olasizmi?

commonMistake.whyUz:
MULOYIM ILTIMOS → 'CAN YOU ...?'

⚠ 'COULD you ...?' ham to'g'ri (muloyimroq).

'tell somebody THE WAY TO ...' — turg'un
ibora.
'Excuse me' — notanish odamga murojaat.

items.sentence: 12  '..................... did you go out with?'  'James.'

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: javob ODAM ISMI ('James') → WHO.

⚠ Predlog 'WITH' GAP OXIRIDA qoladi:
  'WHO did you go out WITH?'  ✓
  'With who did you go out?' — juda rasmiy
     ('With WHOM ...?')

items.sentence: 13  He could talk when he was one, but he ..................... walk.
items.uz: U bir yoshida gapira olardi, lekin yura olmasdi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'could' ning INKORI → COULDN'T.

⚠ Keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'couldn't WALK'    ✓
  'couldn't WALKED'  ✗

'could' — 'can' ning O'TMISH shakli.

items.sentence: 14  They ..................... two sons, but they didn't have any daughters.
items.uz: Ularning ikki o'g'li bor edi, lekin qizi yo'q edi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
⚠ TASDIQ → 2-SHAKL 'HAD'.

Bir gapda ikkalasi:
  'They HAD two sons' (tasdiq, 2-shakl)
  'they DIDN'T HAVE any daughters'
     (inkor, asosiy shakl)

have → HAD → had.

items.sentence: 15  'Did he travel by plane?'  'No, ..................... .'

commonMistake.whyUz:
QISQA JAVOB: savoldagi yordamchi fe'l
takrorlanadi.

'DID he travel?' → 'No, he DIDN'T.'

'travel BY plane' — artiklsiz.

items.sentence: 16  '..................... operas did he write?'  'Forty.'

commonMistake.whyUz:
'operas' — SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK → HOW MANY.

Javob 'Forty' — son, demak sanaladigan.

⚠ 'did he WRITE' — asosiy shakl
('did he wrote' XATO).

items.sentence: 17  The supermarket is on the ..................... Oak Street and Hill Street.
items.uz: Supermarket Ouk va Hill ko'chalarining burchagida.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'on the CORNER OF X and Y' = X va Y
ko'chalarining burchagida.

Unit 10 — yo'nalish ko'rsatish lug'ati.

'in the corner' = xona ichidagi burchakda
(boshqa ma'no).

⚠ 'ON your right/left' — predlog 'ON'.

  'It's ON your right.'  ✓
  'It's IN your right.'  ✗
  'It's AT your right.'  ✗

O'xshash: 'on the left-hand side'.

items.sentence: 19  '..................... of music does the band play?'  'Rock.'

commonMistake.whyUz:
'What KIND OF music ...?' = qanday musiqa?

⚠ 'What SORT of' va 'What TYPE of' ham
to'g'ri — uchalasi bir xil ma'no.

'the band' — birlik → DOES.

items.sentence: 20  James ..................... read until he was seven.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'could' ning INKORI → COULDN'T.

13-band bilan bir xil qoida.

'UNTIL he was seven' = yetti yoshgacha
(2-mashqning 7-bandi ham shu predlog).

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  C turning (yoki B turn)
   2  C completed
   3  B at
   4  A wasn't
   5  C those
   6  A in front of
   7  A until
   8  B running
   9  C coast
  10  B The


⚠ 1-BAND — IKKI VARIANT MUMKIN:

  'Take the first TURNING on your left.'
     — Britaniya inglizchasida yo'nalish
       ko'rsatishning ODATIY shakli.

  'Take the first TURN on your left.'
     — bu ham grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri.

  'corner' — bu qurilmada IShLATILMAYDI
     ('take the first corner' — mavjud
      emas).

  Enterprise — BRITANIYA kitobi, shuning
  uchun 'turning' ko'zda tutilgan.


QOLGANLARI NEGA:

 2  'Diana COMPLETED her education in
     Switzerland.'
    ⚠ 'complete one's education' = ta'limni
    TUGATMOQ.
    'studied her education' — takror
       ('study' o'zi o'qish demakdir).
    'cared her education' — mantiqsiz
       ('care ABOUT' bo'lardi).

 3  'She wasn't AT home.'
    ⚠ 'AT home' — turg'un ibora, ARTIKLSIZ.
    'in home' / 'of home' — XATO.

 4  'He WASN'T tired, SO he went to the
     cinema.'
    MANTIQ: 'so' natijani bildiradi.
    Charchamagan → kinoga bordi ✓
    Charchagan → kinoga bordi ✗ (uyga
       borardi)

 5  'There wasn't an airport in THOSE days.'
    ⚠ 'IN THOSE DAYS' = o'sha kunlarda
    (turg'un ibora, O'TMISh haqida).
    'these days' = hozirgi kunlarda
       (HOZIR haqida) — 'wasn't' ga zid!
    'that days' — grammatik XATO
       ('that day' birlik).

 6  'There is a nice garden IN FRONT OF her
     house.'
    'in front of' = oldida, ro'parasida.
    'on her house' — uy USTIDA (mantiqsiz).
    'in her house' — uy IChIDA (bog' uy
       ichida bo'lmaydi).

 7  'She couldn't swim UNTIL she was four.'
    'until' = ... gacha.
    'but she was four' — mantiqsiz.
    'to she was four' — grammatik XATO.

 8  'They didn't have RUNNING water then.'
    ⚠ 'RUNNING WATER' = vodoprovod suvi
    (turg'un birikma).
    'flowing water' / 'moving water' —
       oqayotgan suv (daryo), boshqa ma'no.

 9  'I live on the south COAST of England.'
    ⚠ 'the south COAST' = janubiy SOhIL
    (mamlakat chegarasi).
    'beach' = plyaj (dam olish joyi).
    'seaside' = dengiz bo'yi (dam olish
       joyi sifatida).

10  'THE Amazon River is in South America.'
    ⚠ DARYOLAR oldida DOIM 'THE':
       the Amazon, the Nile, the Thames

    Boshqa 'the' bilan keladiganlar:
       okeanlar (the Atlantic)
       tog' tizmalari (the Alps)
       cho'llar (the Sahara)

    'THE' YO'Q:
       ko'llar (Lake Baikal)
       yakka tog'lar (Mount Everest)
       mamlakatlar (England)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a turning  = burilish
  education  = ta'lim
  Switzerland = Shveytsariya
  to complete = tugatmoq
  in those days = o'sha kunlarda
  in front of = oldida
  until      = ... gacha
  running water = vodoprovod suvi
  the coast  = sohil
  a beach    = plyaj
  the seaside = dengiz bo'yi

items.textEn: 1  Take the first ................. on your left.
items.whyUz:
⚠ IKKI VARIANT MUMKIN:
'TURNING' — Britaniya inglizchasining odatiy
shakli (Enterprise — Britaniya kitobi).
'TURN' — bu ham grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri.

'corner' — bu qurilmada ISHLATILMAYDI.

⚠ 'COMPLETE one's education' = ta'limni
TUGATMOQ.

'studied her education' — TAKROR ('study'
o'zi o'qish demakdir).
'cared her education' — mantiqsiz
('care ABOUT something' bo'lardi).

⚠ 'AT home' — TURG'UN IBORA, ARTIKLSIZ.

1-mashqning 5-bandi ham shu:
'Where were you? — AT HOME.'

O'xshash: at work, at school.

items.textEn: 4  He ................. tired, so he went to the cinema.
items.uz: U charchamagan edi, shuning uchun kinoga bordi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ MANTIQ: 'SO' natijani bildiradi.

CharchaMAGAN → kinoga bordi  ✓
Charchagan → kinoga bordi     ✗ (uyga
   borardi)

'had tired' — grammatik XATO.

items.textEn: 5  There wasn't an airport in ................. days.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'IN THOSE DAYS' = o'sha kunlarda
(turg'un ibora, O'TMISH haqida).

'these days' = HOZIRGI kunlarda — 'WASN'T'
ga ZID!
'that days' — XATO ('that DAY' birlik).

items.textEn: 6  There is a nice garden ................. her house.
items.uz: Uning uyi oldida chiroyli bog' bor.
items.whyUz:
'IN FRONT OF' = oldida, ro'parasida.

'ON her house' — uy USTIDA (mantiqsiz).
'IN her house' — uy ICHIDA (bog' uy ichida
bo'lmaydi).

O'xshash: behind (orqasida), next to (yonida).

items.textEn: 7  She couldn't swim ................. she was four.
items.whyUz:
'UNTIL' = ... gacha.

1-mashqning 20-bandi ham shu:
'James couldn't read UNTIL he was seven.'

'but she was four' — mantiqsiz.
'to she was four' — grammatik XATO.

items.uz: O'shanda ularda vodoprovod suvi yo'q edi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'RUNNING WATER' = VODOPROVOD suvi
(turg'un birikma).

'flowing water' / 'moving water' = oqayotgan
suv (daryo, soy) — boshqa ma'no.

Unit 9 — o'tmishdagi hayot mavzusi.

items.textEn: 9  I live on the south ................. of England.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'the south COAST' = janubiy SOHIL
(mamlakatning geografik chegarasi).

'a beach' = plyaj (qumli dam olish joyi).
'the seaside' = dengiz bo'yi (dam olish joyi
sifatida).

items.textEn: 10  ................. Amazon River is in South America.
items.whyUz:
⚠ DARYOLAR oldida DOIM 'THE':
  THE Amazon, THE Nile, THE Thames

Yana 'the' bilan: okeanlar (the Atlantic),
tog' tizmalari (the Alps), cho'llar (the
Sahara).

'the' YO'Q: ko'llar (Lake Baikal), yakka
tog'lar (Mount Everest), mamlakatlar.

exercises.explanationUz:
BEShTA DIALOG — SAVOLNI TOPISh KERAK.

⚠ DIQQAT: 1, 2, 3, 4-bandlarda savolning
BIR QISMI allaqachon bosilgan — faqat
BOShINI to'ldirish kerak.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: 'WHAT TIME DID YOU get up yesterday?'
    B: 'Seven o'clock in the morning.'

 2  A: 'WHERE DID YOU live when you were
        young?'
    B: 'I lived in Glasgow.'

 3  A: 'WHEN WAS THE LAST TIME you had a
        haircut?'
    B: 'I had a haircut a month ago.'

 4  A: 'WHY DID YOU LEAVE early?'
    B: 'I left early because I was very
        tired.'

 5  A: 'WHEN DID HE DIE?'
    B: 'He died on 3rd October, 1965.'


QANDAY TOPILADI:

 1  Bosilgan: '... get up yesterday?'
    Javob: 'SEVEN O'CLOCK in the morning.'
    → SOAT so'ralgan
    → 'What time did you ...?'

 2  Bosilgan: '... live when you were young?'
    Javob: 'I lived IN GLASGOW.'
    → JOY so'ralgan
    → 'Where did you ...?'

 3  Bosilgan: '... you had a haircut?'
    Javob: 'I had a haircut A MONTH AGO.'
    → VAQT so'ralgan
    → 'When was the last time ...?'

    ⚠ 1-mashqning 4-bandi AYNAN shu qurilma:
    'When was the LAST TIME you visited your
     parents?'

 4  Bosilgan: '... early?'
    Javob: 'I left early BECAUSE I was very
    tired.'
    → SABAB so'ralgan
    → 'Why did you leave early?'

 5  Javob: 'He died ON 3RD OCTOBER, 1965.'
    → SANA so'ralgan
    → 'When did he die?'


⚠ 5-BAND — ENG KO'P XATO QILINADIGAN:

  'When DID he DIE?'  ✓
  'When did he DIED?' ✗

  'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl!

  Javobda esa 2-shakl: 'He DIED.'

  ⚠ 1-mashqning 1-bandi bilan solishtiring:
     'He WAS BORN in 1938 and DIED in 1987.'


⚠ 4-BANDDA 'LEAVE':
  'Why did you LEAVE early?' (asosiy shakl)
  'I LEFT early.' (2-shakl)

  leave → LEFT → left


DIQQAT — 'HAVE A HAIRCUT':
  'to have a haircut' = soch oldirmoq

  'I HAD a haircut a month ago.'
  ⚠ 'a month AGO' — Past Simple bilan.


DIQQAT — SANA O'QILIShI:
  'on 3rd October, 1965'
  → 'on the third of October, nineteen
     sixty-five'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to get up   = turmoq (uyqudan)
  Glasgow     = Glazgo (Shotlandiya shahri)
  a haircut   = soch olish
  to have a haircut = soch oldirmoq
  to leave    = ketmoq
  tired       = charchagan
  to die      = vafot etmoq

points.en: 1  A: What time did you get up yesterday?   B: Seven o'clock in the morning.
points.uz: 1 A: Kecha soat nechchida turdingiz? B: Ertalab soat yettida.
points.noteUz:
KALIT: javob SOAT ('Seven o'clock')
→ 'What time ...?'

'... get up yesterday?' allaqachon bosilgan —
faqat savolning boshini to'ldirish kerak.

points.en: 2  A: Where did you live when you were young?   B: I lived in Glasgow.
points.uz: 2 A: Yoshligingizda qayerda yashaganingiz? B: Glazgoda yashaganman.

points.en: 3  A: When was the last time you had a haircut?   B: I had a haircut a month ago.
points.uz: 3 A: Oxirgi marta qachon soch oldirgansiz? B: Bir oy oldin.
points.noteUz:
KALIT: javob VAQT ('a month ago').

⚠ 1-mashqning 4-bandi AYNAN shu qurilma:
'When was the LAST TIME you visited your
parents?'

'have a haircut' = soch oldirmoq.

points.en: 4  A: Why did you leave early?   B: I left early because I was very tired.
points.uz: 4 A: Nega erta ketdingiz? B: Erta ketdim, chunki juda charchagan edim.
points.noteUz:
KALIT: javobda 'BECAUSE' bor → SABAB
so'ralgan → 'Why ...?'

'did you LEAVE' (asosiy shakl) ↔
'I LEFT' (2-shakl).
leave → LEFT → left.

points.en: 5  A: When did he die?   B: He died on 3rd October, 1965.
points.uz: 5 A: U qachon vafot etgan? B: 1965-yil 3-oktyabrda.
points.noteUz:
KALIT: javob SANA → 'When ...?'

⚠ ENG KO'P XATO:
  'When DID he DIE?'  ✓
  'When did he DIED?' ✗

Sana o'qilishi: 'on the third of October,
nineteen sixty-five'.

patterns.exampleEn: What time did you get up? Where did you live? Why did you leave? When did he die?
patterns.exampleUz: Soat nechchida turdingiz? Qayerda yashadingiz? Nega ketdingiz? U qachon vafot etdi?
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'did' dan keyin DOIM ASOSIY shakl
('did he died' XATO).

patterns.formula: [ega] WAS BORN in [yil] and DIED in [yil].
patterns.exampleEn: He was born in 1938 and died in 1987.

patterns.formula: When was the LAST TIME you + [2-SHAKL] ... ?
patterns.exampleEn: When was the last time you visited your parents / had a haircut?
patterns.exampleUz: Oxirgi marta qachon ota-onangizni ko'rgansiz / soch oldirgansiz?

patterns.exampleEn: He could talk when he was one, but he couldn't walk.
patterns.exampleUz: U bir yoshida gapira olardi, lekin yura olmasdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'could' — 'can' ning o'tmish shakli.
Keyin ASOSIY shakl.

patterns.formula: Excuse me, CAN/COULD you tell me THE WAY TO + [joy]?
patterns.exampleEn: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the bank?
patterns.exampleUz: Kechirasiz, bankka boradigan yo'lni ayta olasizmi?
patterns.explanationUz:
'Could you ...?' — muloyimroq.
Javob: 'Take the first turning on your left.'
